setup.zh: 告示上写：天旱三年，泾渭俱竭；太华山上有蛇六足四翼，饮水不止。有能致雨者，雍令重赏。城里的老人说，他们的曾祖见过：周亡那年，东边来了九辆车，车上盖着布，赶车的说是鼎；进了城，布一掀，车上什么也没有。坊市里摆着球琳琅玕，没人买——井都干了。
setup.en: The notice says: three years of drought, the Jing and the Wei both dry; on Mount Taihua a snake with six legs and four wings drinks without end. Whoever brings rain, the magistrate of Yong will reward. The old men of the city say their great-grandfathers saw it: the year Zhou fell, nine carts came from the east, their loads under cloth — cauldrons, the drivers said. Inside the walls the cloth came off, and the carts were empty. The market has jade and langgan laid out, and no one buying — the wells are dry.

recap.zh: 雍城的老人说，周亡那年九辆车运鼎进城，掀开布，车上是空的。
recap.en: The old men of Yongcheng said that the year Zhou fell nine carts brought the cauldrons in — and when the cloth came off, the carts were empty.

text.en: …Empty. She got there ahead of them.

alone.zh: 车是空的——有人赶在了秦人前头。
alone.en: The carts were empty: someone had got ahead of the men of Qin.

text.zh: 太华山在东边。那条蛇就盘在山崖上。
text.en: Mount Taihua lies east. The snake is coiled on its cliffs.

exits.means: goes east to Mount Taihua, to the snake

text.zh: 你往东走。太华山削成四方，高五千仞，崖上连一只鸟也没有。
text.en: East. Mount Taihua stands cut square, five thousand ren high; not a bird on its cliffs.

exits.means: goes shopping, asks about the market, wants to buy or sell

text.zh: 卖玉的人把球、琳、琅玕摆了一地，说：拿一块玉换一桶水，也换不来。
text.en: The jade-seller has spread his qiu, lin and langgan across the ground: a piece of jade for a bucket of water, he says, and still no taker.

exits.means: joins the old men praying for rain at the shrine

text.zh: 你跪在老人们中间。天上一丝云也没有。一个老人说：从前旱的时候，人们用泥做一条龙，雨就来了。
text.en: You kneel among the old men. Not a wisp of cloud. One of them says: in the old days, in a drought, people made a dragon of mud, and the rain came.

alone.zh: 旱而为应龙之状，乃得大雨。
alone.en: In drought make the shape of Yinglong, and great rain comes.
